stories.title: Espí vuelve a rescatar a un Real Madrid que se desconectó ante el Elche

en.title: Espí rescues Real Madrid again as team disconnected against Elche
en.summary: Real Madrid's forward Espí scored a winning goal in the 92nd minute against Elche. The team squandered a two-goal lead under Mourinho's management without securing the match earlier.

stories.title: Un trabajador muerto y otro herido grave al limpiar una fosa séptica del Mercado Central de Tarragona

en.title: One worker dead and another seriously injured while cleaning septic tank at Tarragona Central Market
en.summary: A fatal accident occurred at the Central Market's basement level parking where workers were performing repairs on a drainage system. One worker died and another sustained serious injuries.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran se defiende tras la expulsión del rapero Macklemore de su gira por apoyar a Palestina: "El sufrimiento y el dolor causado en los dos bandos es una tragedia humana"

en.title: Ed Sheeran defends himself after rapper Macklemore expelled from his tour for supporting Palestine: "Suffering and pain on both sides is a human tragedy"
en.summary: Rapper Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour for his Palestine support statements. Sheeran stated the decision was made solely by the tour promoters and acknowledged suffering exists on both sides.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza aplicar la amnistía a Puigdemont por la malversación

en.title: Llarena rejects applying amnesty to Puigdemont for embezzlement
en.summary: Spanish Supreme Court judge Pablo Llarena denied Catalan former president Carles Puigdemont's request to apply the Amnesty Law regarding embezzlement charges. The arrest warrant against Puigdemont remains in effect.

stories.title: Un boicot al Festival de las Ideas se lleva por delante a su principal patrocinador

en.title: A boycott of the Festival of Ideas removes its main sponsor
en.summary: Around twenty participants of the Festival of Ideas boycotted the event due to Allianz's sponsorship, leading the German insurance company to withdraw. The organizers lose 150,000 euros in funding just days before the festival begins.

stories.title: Claudia, la estudiante asesinada en México, murió en un pueblo «peligroso» a una hora de su universidad

en.title: Claudia, the student murdered in Mexico, died in a "dangerous" town an hour from her university
en.summary: A university student was killed in Cuautla, a city located 52 kilometers from her campus in Morelos, where she had traveled to attend a medicinal plants event. Local sources describe the area as dangerous.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran se pronuncia sobre la polémica expulsión de Macklemore de su gira: “Yo elijo utilizar mi fama para ofrecer un espacio seguro”

en.title: Ed Sheeran speaks out on the controversial expulsion of Macklemore from his tour: "I choose to use my fame to offer a safe space"
en.summary: Ed Sheeran stated that the promoter, not himself, decided to remove Macklemore as an opening act from upcoming U.S. concerts following the rapper's support for Palestine. Sheeran explained his preference not to discuss political matters publicly.

stories.title: El asesinato de la estudiante en México deriva en una polémica con la Universidad: una alerta previa al viaje advertía de "un repunte de la violencia" en Morelos

en.title: The murder of the student in Mexico leads to controversy with the university: a prior alert to the trip warned of "a spike in violence" in Morelos
en.summary: A university vice-rector claims the destination institution failed to inform her of three previous student murders on campus before approving the trip. A pre-travel alert had warned of increased violence in the Morelos region.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza aplicar la amnistía a Puigdemont y mantiene la orden nacional de detención contra el líder de Junts

en.title: Llarena rejects applying amnesty to Puigdemont and maintains national arrest warrant against Junts leader
en.summary: The Supreme Court judge has upheld his refusal to apply amnesty to fugitive Carles Puigdemont, citing the misappropriation of funds for personal financial benefit as grounds for maintaining the arrest warrant.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza levantar la orden de detención de Puigdemont a la espera del TC

en.title: Llarena rejects lifting Puigdemont's arrest warrant pending TC ruling
en.summary: A Supreme Court judge argues that a European Court of Justice ruling did not address an exception in the law regarding embezzlement charges, maintaining the arrest warrant against the former Catalan president.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza aplicar la amnistía a Puigdemont por el delito de malversación tras el aval del TJUE a la ley

en.title: Llarena refuses to apply amnesty to Puigdemont for embezzlement following TJUE backing of law
en.summary: The Supreme Court judge maintains an arrest warrant against the former Catalan president for embezzlement charges while leaving open the possibility of applying amnesty at a later stage.

stories.title: Allianz retira su patrocinio de 124.000 euros al Festival de las Ideas tras una campaña de boicot por su colaboración con Israel

en.title: Allianz withdraws 124,000 euros sponsorship from Festival of Ideas following boycott campaign over Israel collaboration
en.summary: Insurance company Allianz ended its sponsorship of a festival after artists and public figures suspended their participation to pressure the company regarding its Israel-related activities.

stories.title: El Senado de EEUU bloquea la nueva ley de criptomonedas y las deja en el limbo

en.title: US Senate blocks new cryptocurrency law, leaving digital assets in regulatory limbo
en.summary: The US Senate rejected a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrency proposed by Republicans because Democrats opposed the lack of restrictions on government officials.

stories.title: El Ibex salva la sesión y cierra en tablas pese a la presión del petróleo y la deuda

en.title: Ibex holds session and closes flat despite pressure from oil and debt
en.summary: The Spanish Ibex index ended the day unchanged as oil prices, debt concerns, and Federal Reserve decisions pressured markets, though it managed to partially recover from previous losses linked to AI-related stocks.

stories.title: El petróleo retoma su escalada y vuelve a rozar los 109 dólares

en.title: Oil resumes its climb and approaches 109 dollars
en.summary: Crude oil prices increased as Saudi Arabia delayed shipments to some European customers this month.

stories.title: Renault apuntala en Brasil su alianza global con la china Geely

en.title: Renault strengthens global alliance with Chinese Geely in Brazil
en.summary: Renault and Chinese automaker Geely will invest 319 million dollars to produce an electrified model in Brazil, bringing their total investment in the country to nearly 900 million since 2025.

stories.title: Inditex nombrará a Marta Andreia Rodrigues directora de Zara Woman

en.title: Inditex appoints Marta Andreia Rodrigues as director of Zara Woman
en.summary: Inditex has appointed Marta Andreia Rodrigues as director of Zara Woman. She previously led the womenswear division at Pull&Bear for the past year and a half and had held other roles in Zara Basic.
